Package com.bilt.pos.media.service

Class AdSessionSnapshot

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.media.service.AdSessionSnapshot
public final class AdSessionSnapshot extends Object
What the ad decision service needs to know about a shopper session, at one moment.

A snapshot is the widget's projection of the checkout: where it is happening, what is in the basket, who (if anyone) is identified, and which phase the checkout is in. It is a value the widget rebuilds and hands over in full on every AdDecisionService.updateSession(com.bilt.pos.media.service.SessionHandle, com.bilt.pos.media.service.AdSessionSnapshot); the service diffs if it cares. It carries no session object, so the service contract does not move when the session API does.

getPhase() is a free-form string for now — "browsing", "tendering", "complete" as the widget names them. A typed CheckoutPhase enum arrives in a later ticket and will replace the string; callers should treat the value as opaque until then.

getMemberId() is the only personal identifier and is present only for an identified member; the platform, not the SDK, resolves it to a profile.
